name: web-research
description: Deep web search and content fetching via local AI proxy — search the web with Gemini and fetch page content with Jina Reader or Exa.

interface.shortDescription: Web search & content fetching for deep research.
interface.longDescription: Web Research provides deep web search (via Gemini) and web page content fetching (via Jina Reader or Exa) through a local API proxy. Use it to search the web, fetch article content as markdown, and power deep research workflows directly inside Codex.
defaultPrompt: Search the web and summarize the latest news about a topic.
Fetch a web page and extract its content as markdown.
Do deep research: search multiple queries and fetch key pages.
